user.title: SHC NDv2
user.description: Local control of Smart Home Control NDv2 devices (firmware 3.x). Devices are discovered automatically over multicast 239.5.0.2:5202; no device needs to be added by hand.

data_description.interface: Leave 0.0.0.0 to use the default interface. On hosts with several networks, enter the IP of the interface on the devices' network.

confirm.title: SHC NDv2
confirm.description: {count} NDv2 device(s) answered right now. Devices that are offline or that appear later are added automatically.

error.cannot_bind: Could not open UDP port 5202 or join multicast group 239.5.0.2. Check that Home Assistant uses host networking.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only one instance is allowed.

data_description.reconcile_minutes: Real-time updates come from multicast. This low-frequency check only repairs states lost to dropped packets.

command_not_confirmed.message: {device} did not confirm the command. The state was requested again.

cannot_bind.message: Could not open the NDv2 network socket: {error}
